title: A page item's `Departs from:` line about what main does is read from main's files before it posts
why: Incident (the lane of review-record-allow-entry via the coordinator, 15:09 CST Nov 14; n=1): item 839 stated "Departs from: main — no rule names `merge --review-record`" as fact; main already allows the bare form (entry "Merge Tool Read Checks"). The line came from a relayed report and was posted unchecked; the owner chose option a on that text (the grant stands, scope narrowed to flags). Guard that would have stopped it (rule building-mistake-names-its-guard): the writer of the page reads the cited file or setting before the Departs from line says what main does, or marks the line "relayed, unread". Rule: verification-report-unknown-reads. Not built: first act of a lane is to check whether question_form.py can compare a Departs from claim about main with a file named on the item, or whether the check is a writer step in skill waiting-page.
note: Filed 15:11 CST Nov 14 by triage (my miss: posted an unread premise). Tracker: the coordinator.
